caption: The video captures a woman dancing in a studio whose wall mirror reflects her on the left, while dark curtains, a ballet barre, and a rack of colorful garments fill the background. She wears a tan elbow-sleeve top and gray sweatpants, hair pinned with a light clip, a sheer pale-mint scarf looped around her arms and waist. In the opening frames she is bent forward at the waist with flexed knees, hands low, the scarf trailing near the floor. She straightens upward and opens her arms wide, lifting the scarf's ends so it spreads horizontally across her back. Her body then rotates from a back-to-camera stance into a profile and face-visible pose, one arm overhead, the other extended outward. The scarf shifts from hanging low to streaming in broad arcs above her raised hand. Her position drifts rightward, and the mirror reflection follows her movements.
relations: As she straightens upward, the pale-mint scarf lifts from the floor and spreads horizontally across her back.
Her rotation into a profile pose raises one arm overhead while the other extends outward.
The scarf shifts from hanging low to streaming in broad arcs above her raised hand.
As she drifts rightward, her mirror reflection on the left follows the same continuous movement.
